name: OpenMetadata
description: OpenMetadata metadata/data-catalog platform, installed bare-metal (Java 21 server, MySQL, OpenSearch, Airflow ingestion orchestrator in a Python venv).

notes.text: Airflow bare-metal integration is best-effort: upstream only documents Airflow as a generic requirement, not the exact REST-plugin wiring used inside their Docker image. This script installs Airflow 3.3 + openmetadata-ingestion[airflow] (same plugin package used in the official image) in a Python 3.12 venv, but the UI-driven ingestion scheduling should be verified after install.
OpenSearch runs with its Security plugin fully disabled (DISABLE_SECURITY_PLUGIN=true) for simplicity - no TLS, no auth on port 9200. Only expose this LXC on a trusted network.
Not intended for production use as-is: default credentials, no auth on internal services (MySQL/OpenSearch), single-host only.
First start can take a few minutes while MySQL/OpenSearch/Airflow bootstrap and the server runs its schema migration.

Default login: admin@open-metadata.org / admin. Airflow (ingestion UI) credentials are generated at install time and saved to ~/openmetadata.creds on the container. Change both before exposing this instance beyond your local network.
